title: H-HANDOFF-1 part A, the CLIENT'S GYM (fx-hq1 '60 ba:street_fifthavenue'): both inside with at least 6 gym customers; the client (owner, simulator) walks out and the host continues the crowd with the entrance fee NOT charged again (one fee line per order after adoption); the client walks back in and takes it back the same way; then the DISCONNECT leg - the client quits while simulating and the host adopts from the continuous visit-row stream alone ('S with state' > 0). PART B (batch 27): after each adoption the taker's adopted gym customers are on the SAME machine with the row's end time (custstate held: heldMismatch=0, endDelta <= 1 game minute), and after the leg-2 AUTHORITY SWAP the giving host holds no leaked seat / line / slot / table spot / dance spot. NO save.
preconditions:
Reporter fixture session fx-hq1 (day 44, MERGED - vars.keepMerger true). Dev build with H-HANDOFF-1. Setup as T-HANDOFF1: both step outside and take one consensus skip outdoors to 10:45 the next morning. The gym is the CLIENT's (t-shopday-pick: 180-203 entries a day), so the client books it and simulates it whenever he is inside.

WHY THE GYM: GymCustomer.Init pays the entrance fee (Customer.PayEntranceFee :224-238) and IndoorCustomerSpawner.SpawnCustomer appends the fee line first (TryToProcessEntranceFeeEntryToOrder :284-307); before H-HANDOFF-1 an adopted body got a SECOND fee line and paid again. `custstate` prints feeMax = the most fee lines on any live order; after each adoption it must read 1, and the adoption line must show 'fee suppressed=' > 0.

DISCONNECT LEG: with the client simulating and the host following, the host must already hold stream rows for its copies (custstate copyRows > 0 - user ruling (a), 2026-09-26: the continuous on-change stream). The client is then DROPPED (rig teardown of that instance); the host's election makes it the simulator with no Final possible, and it adopts from the stream rows: the native-mode line must say '(S with state' with S > 0 and via no-final or left. ORACLE NOTE: NullReferenceException carries the `(?<!swallowed )` lookbehind (fx-hq1's own Gley diagnostic).
